# procd-exported-helpers.txt — the complete procd_* helper API of OpenWrt
# 25.12, extracted verbatim from the upstream export list:
#   openwrt/openwrt  package/system/procd/files/procd.sh
#   (the `_procd_wrapper` export block; the file is installed as
#    /lib/functions/procd.sh and sourced by /etc/rc.common)
#
# Dev-time fixture only (T070): never installed on a device, never used at
# runtime. It exists so the service-startup audit can prove that the init
# script calls only helpers upstream actually exports.
#
# NOTE: procd_add_restart_trigger is deliberately ABSENT — upstream does
# not export it. Calling it produced
#   "procd: /etc/rc.d/S99saadway: line 45: procd_add_restart_trigger: not found"
# (the replacement is procd_add_reload_trigger).
